name: Adi Gallia's flagship
description: Adi Gallia's flagship was a Venator-class Star Destroyer commanded by Jedi Master Adi Gallia during the Clone Wars. It was destroyed in a battle near the planet Patitite Pattuna by General Grievous's forces, and Gallia was subsequently taken prisoner by the Confederate General.

data.name: Adi Gallia's flagship
data.destroyed: c. 21 BBY, space near Patitite Pattuna
